titles.1219767934: Halaji Tara Hath Vakhanu — Rushabh Ahir Live

sections.title: Absolute Cinema
sections.blurb: Pure colour and composition. Film-grade looks built from scratch — highlight roll-off, split-toned shadows, restrained contrast — on footage that has to carry a mood before a single word is spoken.

sections.title: Concert Edits
sections.blurb: Ankit Tiwari live at Nirma. Stage lighting is the hardest grade there is — blown highlights, coloured wash, no second take. Cut to the performance, graded to keep skin tones intact under moving colour.

sections.title: Masking & Compositing
sections.blurb: Frame-by-frame masking and compositing: subjects lifted from their plates, type threaded behind moving bodies, elements placed inside the scene so the graphic reads as part of the shot.

sections.title: Motion Graphics
sections.blurb: After Effects motion work: velocity-driven type, kinetic layout and title systems that move with the cut rather than sitting on top of it. Horizontal and vertical builds.

sections.title: Fast-Paced Montage
sections.blurb: Seven montages cut to the beat. Frame-accurate sync, speed-ramped transitions and a build that keeps escalating — the format that holds a scrolling viewer past the three-second mark.

sections.title: Brand Films
sections.blurb: A full campaign for Conroy — one cinematic hero film cut for the brand's landing page, then nine vertical reels carved out of the same shoot for Instagram and YouTube Shorts. One grade, one rhythm, ten deliverables.

sections.title: Event Edits
sections.blurb: Live folk concerts, campus activations and hackathons. Multi-cam coverage cut to the energy of the room, delivered in both horizontal recap and vertical reel formats so the client can post everywhere from one shoot.

sections.title: Event GFX Animation
sections.blurb: Broadcast-style graphics package for a hackathon — animated title sequence, lower thirds and stingers built to hold up on a projector and on a phone.

sections.title: 3D Visualization
sections.blurb: Product visualisation built in 3D — a card rendered, lit and animated for a vertical spot, then graded to match the rest of the brand's footage.

sections.title: Smooth Movie Edits
sections.blurb: The opposite discipline. Long, unhurried cuts that let a performance breathe, with transitions you feel rather than notice.

sections.title: Podcast Edits
sections.blurb: Multi-cam podcast editing — clean speaker cuts, dead-air tightening, dialogue levelling and a consistent grade across cameras that never quite match.

sections.title: Vlog Montage
sections.blurb: Travel and lifestyle montage cut for retention: strong cold open, momentum through the middle, a landing that earns the last frame.

sections.title: Nostalgic Edits
sections.blurb: Seven quieter edits built on warmth and restraint — grain, gentle halation, typography used as punctuation. Made to feel remembered rather than watched.

sections.title: Anime Colour Grading
sections.blurb: Grading animation is a different problem to grading footage — flat cel colour, hard line art, no film response to lean on. These rebuild depth and atmosphere into already-finished frames.

sections.title: Fast-Paced Anime
sections.blurb: High-intensity anime edits: rotation and shake rigs, impact frames, transitions timed to the frame. Technical exercises in how hard a cut can hit.

sections.title: Personal Edits
sections.blurb: Edits made for no client and no brief — where the transitions and grades that later end up in commercial work get tried out first.

skills.name: Colour Grading
skills.desc: The reason most edits either feel cinematic or feel flat. Primary balance, secondary isolation, split-toned shadows and highlight roll-off — building a look that carries the mood of the story instead of sitting on a LUT.

skills.name: After Effects — VFX & Compositing
skills.desc: Where the hard problems get solved. Multi-layer compositing, clean-up, screen replacement, light wrap and integration work that makes added elements read as though they were shot in camera.

skills.name: Video Rescue
skills.desc: Underexposed, noisy, wrongly white-balanced, shot on the wrong settings — I can take footage a client has written off and pull a usable, good-looking cut out of it. Denoise, recover, regrade, stabilise, resharpen.

skills.name: Masking & Rotoscoping
skills.desc: Frame-by-frame subject isolation. Type that passes behind a moving person, objects removed from a plate, selective grades that follow a face through a shot.

skills.name: Motion Tracking
skills.desc: 2D and camera tracking to pin graphics, text and replacements into moving footage so they hold their place through handheld, whip pans and speed ramps.

skills.name: Logo & Brand Animation
skills.desc: Identity in motion — logo builds, stingers and end cards with easing and weight that match how the brand is supposed to feel.

skills.name: Kinetic Typography
skills.desc: Type treated as a performer. Layout, timing and velocity worked so the words land on the beat and carry meaning rather than just filling frame.

skills.name: Cinematography
skills.desc: Full working knowledge of the camera — exposure triangle, shutter angle, picture profiles, log capture, lens choice and movement. I can shoot the footage I'd want to be handed as an editor.

skills.name: Lighting
skills.desc: Shaping with key, fill and separation, colour temperature control and practical sources — so the grade starts from something worth grading.

skills.name: Premiere Pro
skills.desc: The assembly room. Multi-cam sync, proxy workflows, nested sequence structures and delivery-ready exports for every platform spec.

skills.name: CapCut Advance
skills.desc: Pushed well past template territory. Used deliberately for speed on short-form turnarounds where a same-day deliverable matters more than a round trip.

skills.name: Live Stream Banner Animation
skills.desc: Looping overlays, animated lower thirds, scoreboards and transition stingers built to run live without dropping frames.

skills.name: Sound Engineering
skills.desc: Dialogue cleanup, levelling and de-noising, music bedding, ducking and sound design hits. Half of how 'cinematic' an edit feels is what you're hearing.

skills.name: Creative Direction
skills.desc: Turning a loose brief into a treatment — reference, structure, pacing and look decided before the timeline opens.

skills.name: Content Creation
skills.desc: Understanding the platform as well as the craft: hooks, retention curves, aspect ratios and what actually makes someone stop scrolling.

services.name: Cinematic Colour Grading
services.desc: Mood-driven grading that gives footage a premium, film-like look. Shot matching across cameras, skin tones protected, a bespoke look built per project — not a preset dropped on a timeline.

services.name: Motion Graphics & Typography
services.desc: Text animation, title systems and animated graphics that make content stand out and hold a viewer's eye exactly where you need it.

services.name: Reels & Short-Form
services.desc: Fast-paced, trend-driven vertical edits built for reach — engineered around the hook, the beat and the loop.

services.name: Long-Form & After-Movies
services.desc: YouTube episodes, event after-movies and documentary-style cuts structured for retention from cold open to end card.

services.name: High-Impact Action Edits
services.desc: Heavy-editing builds — speed ramps, impact frames, camera shake rigs, compositing and effects work for edits that need to hit hard.

services.name: Trending Effects & Transitions
services.desc: Viral editing styles and transitions applied with judgement, to lift engagement without making the work look disposable.
